name: Alliance Showdown
description: Six days of tasks, similar to SvS and KOI, against an alliance of similar power in another state. It runs together with the Tundra Trade Route event.
frequency: Every 4 weeks, after the SvS week. It replaces one of the Alliance Mobilization slots in eligible states.
duration: 6 days. Day 6 runs 12 hours into Sunday.
requirements: You must be in the alliance before the event starts. Changing alliance after the start means you cannot take part in your new alliance.
Ranking rewards need at least 300,000 personal points from the member and 20,000,000 total alliance points
